Name: Holes and Falling
Author: BussinBungus
Description:
[size=3][img]https://imgur.com/IJJZhSN.png[/img]
This mod is an updated and rewritten combination of two mods I was missing on SDV 1.6: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2558]BetterSkullCavernFalling [/url]by MaxMakesMods and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13471]Portable Holes[/url] by LeFauxMatt. It's possible to toggle features from either mod off in the config if you only want one of the mods. Supports integration with Generic Mod Config Menu and Iconic Framework, as well as i18n if you wish to make a translation.

[img]https://imgur.com/BakqbP4.png[/img]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]If installing manually, extract the mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/size]
[*][size=3]If installing via mod manager, download using your manager and install normally.[/size]
[*][size=3]To uninstall, simply delete the mod from your mods folder.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[img]https://imgur.com/ydh4KOT.png[/img]
After running the game with the mod installed, you can edit the mod's config with GMCM or directly in the config.json that is generated. There are five config settings that can be edited:

[b]cornerMessage [/b](default: true)- Enables the less obtrusive corner HUD message instead of the pop-up dialog when falling.
[b]portableHole [/b](default: true) - Allows the Portable Hole item to be crafted at Mining 10.
[b]holeRecipe[/b] (default: "(BC)71 1 769 5") - The ingredients to craft a Portable Hole, as a sequence of alternating item IDs and quantities.
[b]unlockHoleAutomatically[/b] (default: false) - Instantly unlocks the Portable Hole recipe, even before Mining 10.
[b]softFall[/b] (default: false) - Disables taking damage while falling down a hole.

[img]https://imgur.com/fZl1ltM.png[/img]
No known issues right now! I believe the mod should work in multiplayer though I haven't tested this fully. If you have any issues, please report them!

[img]https://imgur.com/LwQh4WG.png[/img]
Thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/MaxMakesMods]MaxMakesMods[/url] and [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/LeFauxMatt?gameId=1303]LeFauxMatt [/url]for making the two mods that inspired this one, and to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/mrtaiyou]Tai [/url]for making the original hole texture!

Also thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1552317]Pathoschild[/url] for making SMAPI, [url=https://www.kdau.com/scrollish/]kdau [/url]for the scroll generator, and the SDV Discord for their advice!

Lastly, some other mining-related mods I'd recommend you try with this one include [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27825]Confirm Mine Ladder[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35477]Ladder Chance Framework[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7787]BetterBombs[/url],[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22592] Passable Descents[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8564]Safe Reading[/url]. Happy spelunking!
